A glowing green targeting reticle tracks across the glass with lock-on brackets snapping onto a distant ship, range numerals ticking down beside it.
A holographic nav-map glows in one corner of the canopy, a course-line threading glowing waypoint markers toward a distant planet.
Rows of amber system-readouts and a damage-schematic of the ship hover on the inside of the glass, one warning light pulsing red.
A velocity ladder scrolls upward along the left edge of the canopy, altitude numerals cascading beside it in cold blue light.
Scrolling green comms text streams across the lower canopy glass, fragmented transmissions and call-signs ghosting over the starfield beyond.
A ship-schematic glows on the glass, hull sections shading from green to deep red where rear shields have taken damage.
Alien glyphs pulse across the upper canopy, a translation overlay flickering beneath each symbol as the decryption algorithm works line by line.
A horizon-and-attitude indicator arcs across the center of the glass, a synthetic horizon line tilting as the craft rolls through debris.
Range-finder numerals bloom large on the canopy glass, bracketing a tumbling asteroid and counting meters in sharp amber digits.
A radar display pulses in the lower-right corner, a cluster of hostile blips spreading outward from a central contact marker.
A cyan crosshair holds steady on the canopy while a leading-pip drifts ahead of a weaving target, compensating for closure speed.
Throttle and shield bars glow side by side on the glass, the throttle bar surging white and the shield bar draining slowly blue.
Lock-on brackets close tight around a capital ship, concentric rings contracting as a targeting tone rises and a missile-ready indicator flashes.
A fuel-reserve gauge burns low orange on the canopy edge, projected consumption curves arcing toward empty in seven minutes of flight time.
Wingman-status icons line the upper glass, each tagged with a callsign, one blinking yellow and another going dark as comms cut out.
A weapons-loadout overlay spreads across the lower glass, hardpoint icons cycling from green to grey as ammunition counts deplete in real time.
An energy-distribution triangle rotates softly on the glass, vertex nodes labeled engines, shields, and weapons, the player dragging power between them.
A jump-drive charge indicator swells from empty to full on the starboard canopy edge, rings of white light stacking toward activation threshold.
Proximity-alert chevrons flare red across the upper canopy as a destroyer broadside closes fast, collision-countdown numerals strobing in the center glass.
A stealth-mode overlay dims the entire HUD to near-invisible violet lines, a noise-signature meter creeping just below enemy detection threshold.
Environmental readouts glow across the glass, external temperature, atmospheric pressure, and radiation flux updating as the ship skims a gas giant's upper cloud layer.
An IFF overlay tags every contact on the canopy glass, friendly brackets in blue and hostile brackets in red over the debris field.
Gravity-well contour lines ripple across the nav-glass, a tidal-force gradient warning pulsing where the course-line bends too close to the neutron star.
A mission-timer counts down in the upper canopy corner, objective markers flashing beside target names and glowing priority indicators stacked in amber rows.
A structural-integrity readout paints frame-stress lines across a ship wireframe on the glass, stressed struts glowing orange where the hull flexes under fire.
